paths.title: Choose the first animal
paths.question: Where can we collect useful observations responsibly?
paths.decision: Welcome every animal in the app; validate one species and one observable question first.
paths.next_step: Confirm access to several households with the same parrot species; compare annotation feasibility before committing to a pilot.
paths.gate: Budgerigars are provisional. No recruited participants, expert sign-off, recording uploads or translation model are implied.

paths.title: Capture useful context
paths.question: What should people record and label?
paths.decision: Reuse annotation workflows and independent behavior labels. Make unknowns explicit.
paths.next_step: A synthetic file-exchange check, followed by a species-specific codebook and a reviewer-agreement exercise on approved data.
paths.gate: Real observations require an approved protocol, rights and consent. Public clips are not automatically research data.

paths.title: Find sounds worth reviewing
paths.question: How do we detect events without missing the quiet ones?
paths.decision: Compare existing detectors and encoders against our simple sound-level trigger. Keep a continuous, independently annotated test sample.
paths.next_step: Specify a rights-cleared continuous-audio evaluation with quiet intervals, event recall, false alarms per hour and review time. Use MeerKAT for metric/schema guidance only unless a separately scoped non-commercial reproduction passes its rights and animal/session split review.
paths.gate: Triggered clips alone cannot establish recall. MeerKAT's non-commercial data and checkpoint terms exclude them from the shared commercial-capable path; its public sample names do not expose animal/session groups. Specialized recorders do not establish phone performance.

paths.title: Reuse models, then test transfer
paths.question: Can sound help predict independently observed context?
paths.decision: Start with frozen audio features and a small classifier. Compare against context-only, background and simple acoustic baselines.
paths.next_step: Pin one checkpoint and dataset version, review their separate rights and pretraining overlap, and freeze splits by animal and session before evaluation.
paths.gate: No Talk2Nature animal model has been trained or benchmarked. Language-like output is not verified meaning.

paths.title: Know what would count as understanding
paths.question: When does an association support a claim about meaning?
paths.decision: Study receiver behavior, matched comparisons and competing explanations. Distinguish companion parrots' learned human names from natural conspecific signals proposed as names; keep each critique connected to the original evidence.
paths.next_step: Ask a scientific reviewer to assess one bounded hypothesis and its controls before designing any intervention.
paths.gate: A caregiver report about a human-created name differs from evidence about natural conspecific calls. Neither an individual acoustic signature nor a receiver response alone establishes shared meaning. Public tools remain passive; no automated playback or general translation claim.

paths.title: Connect sound, movement and other signals
paths.question: Which measurements could reveal something audio alone misses?
paths.decision: Use separate evidence standards for animal behavior, plant physiology and fungal electrophysiology.
paths.next_step: Test the notebook workflow now; recruit scientific review for one passive audio-video protocol before expanding sensors.
paths.gate: Current public apps do not capture video, identify species or upload data. Plant ultrasound and fungal electricity need suitable hardware.

paths.title: Design technology around the animal
paths.question: What changes when an animal uses the interface directly?
paths.decision: Use species- and individual-aware interaction design, short optional sessions, and a reliable way to leave; test observable behavior rather than assuming engagement.
paths.next_step: Compare animal-operated tablet tasks with parrot choice in video calls, then ask an animal-computer-interaction researcher to review any future animal-facing design before prototyping.
paths.gate: This evidence concerns touchscreen enrichment, not Talk2Nature’s human-operated passive recorder or a way to communicate meaning. This reading path does not add animal-directed features.

paths.title: Align sound with observed behavior
paths.question: Can an acoustic feature predict a behavior that was independently observed at the same time?
paths.decision: Treat overlap separation as an upstream preprocessing candidate, then evaluate caller attribution and independently observed context as separate tasks. Preserve unknown and mixed-source cases.
paths.next_step: First establish rights and a source-resolved evaluation set. Compare known-source synthetic mixtures with and without separation, then test any downstream context claim on frozen animal/session groups with independent observation labels and appropriate baselines.
paths.gate: BioCPPNet reports validation on constructed mixtures and downstream caller identity; it does not validate natural phone recordings or receiver comprehension, and the reviewed code snapshot has no visible LICENSE. Bat-archive raw-audio rights and joins remain unresolved, and no source is admitted to the first Talk2Nature context benchmark.

paths.title: Retrieve observable events without inventing meaning
paths.question: Can a natural-language query find video clips whose reviewed behavior labels satisfy it?
paths.decision: Treat a prompt as a search interface over an explicit label schema. Evaluate perception, label provenance, prompt parsing and retrieval separately; do not infer vocal meaning from video labels.
paths.next_step: Compare the two MammAlps releases' modalities, splits and licenses, then write a leakage-safe retrieval protocol with held-out individuals or sites before considering a model run.
paths.gate: Prompting-MammAlps is video-only and CC BY-NC 4.0; its code rights are unresolved and its published day split is not verified animal-held-out. Neither MammAlps release establishes animal language or enters the first commercial-capable benchmark.
